checks: The two actual fibers are the extreme-base triangles, each of area 1/2. Strict exposing tilts isolate either positive fiber, and pointwise ambient depth equals its intrinsic depth including at boundary marks.
The Minkowski sum polygon has axis endpoints L+1/L and the corner (L,L). Its other vertex sums lie on axis or diagonal segments. The shoelace area is L(L+1/L), including the collinear vertex at L=1.
The centroid vertex caps are proper homothetic copies of ratio 2/3. A finite exposing base tilt strictly misses the other triangle. Their cap masses are 2/9.

The original edge normal receives length 2/3 of its total from each of the two incident caps. Multipliers 3/4 reproduce each original normal measure. Full cap area measures give a distinct aggregate scaling 3/2, hence area (9/4)(L²+1), although the weighted sum of cap areas is one.
Original 4b6ce6cf06c8f669 §2, (2)–(3), gives this exact indexed pair, not the same-body higher-dimensional containment examples.
